content_of_post_to_comment: Sometimes you do not need to understand yourself more deeply. You need lunch. Sleep. A walk. A quiet room. A day without turning your whole life into a lesson. Not every ache is asking for analysis. Some are asking for care.
comment: A useful distinction: reflection helps when pain contains information, but it becomes avoidance when we use analysis to postpone basic care. Sometimes the first act of understanding is simply meeting the body's needs.
